mainEntity.name: How long does a typical damaged board replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a damaged board replacement project varies depending on the scope and complexity. A small section of deck board might take a few hours, while extensive siding or subfloor replacement could take several days or more. Factors influencing the timeline include the total area affected, the type of material, necessary structural repairs, and weather conditions for exterior work. We provide an estimated timeline with your project proposal, aiming for efficient completion without compromising quality, offering Process Clarity from the outset.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies by scope, material, and damage extent. Small replacements may take hours; larger projects, several days. An estimated timeline is provided with the proposal.
